statement: For original Elite identity the pinned xpad source configures fifteen EV_KEY controls (eight shared buttons, three Xbox shoulder/Guide buttons and four paddles), eight EV_ABS axes (four signed stick axes, two 0-1023 triggers and two hat axes), with no Series Share KEY_RECORD or Elite 2 profile axis. FF_RUMBLE is conditional on the kernel force-feedback configuration; this is an advertised software surface, not a record of emitted physical events.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3 xpad Xbox One Elite mapping
applicability.scope: xpad.c:420-475, 1905-1929, 1973-2033, 1627-1639; compare existing xbox-series-xpad-evdev-shape and xbox-series-xpad-axis-domains. No physical run.
